quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were one to judge purely by the number of self-help books Kwame has purchased on the subject of morning routines, one might assume he has settled into an elaborate, multi-step ritual; in reality, the routine he has stuck with for over a year consists of exactly two elements.
quests.hint: Find what one might assume Kwame has settled into.
quests.explanation: The passage says one might assume an elaborate ritual, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Insofar as the university's writing center has data on the matter, students who attend at least three sessions before submitting a major paper show a measurably lower rate of receiving a revision request from instructors than those who attend once or not at all.
quests.hint: Find what type of request students receive less often.
quests.explanation: The passage says a revision request, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the department's leadership to rely solely on the quarterly satisfaction survey, they would likely conclude that morale had improved substantially following the reorganization; a closer examination of the response rate, however, reveals a more complicated picture.
quests.hint: Find what event morale supposedly improved following.
quests.explanation: The passage says following the reorganization, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the popular assumption correct that direct flights are, without exception, faster than itineraries involving a single connection, travelers would have little reason to ever consider the latter; in practice, certain long-haul routes served only indirectly can arrive sooner than a direct route on older aircraft.
quests.hint: Find what word describes travel plans involving a connection.
quests.explanation: The passage says itineraries involving a connection, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Remarkably, were it not for a particularly blunt conversation with her older cousin, who pointed out that Amara had been unconsciously repeating a caregiving pattern from her own childhood, Amara might never have recognized why she felt so compelled to manage her brother's life.
quests.hint: Find what type of pattern Amara was unconsciously repeating.
quests.explanation: The passage says a caregiving pattern, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the manufacturer's claim to be taken entirely at face value, that its new mattress model outperforms every competitor at a comparable price point across all sleep positions, one would expect independent testing to confirm uniform superiority.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the kind of superiority one would expect.
quests.explanation: The passage says uniform superiority, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the popular belief correct that organic produce is, across the board, nutritionally superior to conventionally grown produce, one would expect controlled nutrient analyses to show a consistent advantage; the actual body of research has found the differences to be inconsistent and generally modest.
quests.hint: Find the word describing how the compared produce was grown.
quests.explanation: The passage says conventionally grown produce, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Crucially, were the widely circulated claim accurate that a particular messaging app's encryption made intercepted messages entirely unreadable under any circumstance, security researchers would have little basis for ongoing concern; a detailed audit found that metadata remained readily accessible despite the strong encryption.
quests.hint: Find what remained readily accessible despite strong encryption.
quests.explanation: The passage says metadata remained accessible, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the assumption correct that chronic under-sleeping primarily affects only cognitive performance, the growing body of research linking sustained sleep deprivation to measurable changes in immune function and long-term cardiovascular risk would be considerably harder to explain.
quests.hint: Find what type of sleep issue has been linked to immune changes.
quests.explanation: The passage says sleep deprivation, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the studio's public explanation for the film's delayed release, that additional time was needed purely for visual effects polish, the complete picture, one would not expect leaked internal memos to reveal extensive last-minute reshoots driven by disappointing test-audience reactions.
quests.hint: Find what the leaked memos revealed had happened.
quests.explanation: The passage says extensive last-minute reshoots, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Importantly, were the common assumption correct that a forest's overall health can be reliably judged simply by the density and height of its trees, conservationists would have little reason to closely monitor understory diversity, yet several visually healthy forests have lost most of it.
quests.hint: Find what conservationists closely monitor besides tree height.
quests.explanation: The passage says understory diversity, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were the city's public rationale for closing the aging community pool, that repair costs had become prohibitively expensive, the complete explanation, one would not expect budget documents to reveal a considerably larger discretionary expenditure approved the very same fiscal year.
quests.hint: Find the word describing how expensive the repair costs were said to be.
quests.explanation: The passage says prohibitively expensive, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Having spent years insisting that a cluttered desk was simply the price of being a creative thinker, Elif reversed her position entirely after a single afternoon spent working in a colleague's spotless office, an experience that left her noticeably calmer than she had anticipated.
quests.hint: Find the word describing Elif's desk before she changed her mind.
quests.explanation: The passage says a cluttered desk, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Were it not for a chance conversation with a former classmate who had taken an unconventional path into the same field, Denzel might never have discovered that the credential he had spent three years assuming was mandatory was, in fact, treated as merely preferred.
quests.hint: Find what Denzel assumed was mandatory for three years.
quests.explanation: The passage says the credential, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given that the sales team had long relied on a single top performer to carry a disproportionate share of quarterly targets, management made a deliberate push to diversify where revenue came from, a strategy that paid off when that performer unexpectedly left mid-year.
quests.hint: Find the word describing the top performer's share of targets.
quests.explanation: The passage says a disproportionate share, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given the volcanic activity that occasionally disrupts flight schedules in the region, most airlines operating routes near the mountain maintain flexible rebooking policies that waive change fees during confirmed periods of ash disruption, a policy worth verifying before booking.
quests.hint: Find what type of policy airlines maintain near the volcano.
quests.explanation: The passage says flexible rebooking policies, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Incidentally, given that her in-laws live only a short drive away, Petra has gradually taken on a role in their lives that goes well beyond the occasional holiday visit, including regular grocery runs and doctor's appointments she never anticipated handling.
quests.hint: Find what Petra has gradually taken on in her in-laws' lives.
quests.explanation: The passage says she has taken on a role, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given how frequently she had been burned by ordering furniture online only to find the color drastically different from the listing photos, Ingrid now makes a point of requesting a physical fabric swatch before committing to any larger purchase.
quests.hint: Find what Ingrid now requests before buying furniture.
quests.explanation: The passage says a physical fabric swatch, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given that the restaurant sources its seafood locally each morning, the menu changes daily depending on what the fishing boats happen to bring in, a level of unpredictability that regular customers have come to expect rather than resist.
quests.hint: Find what regular customers have come to expect from the menu.
quests.explanation: The passage says this unpredictability, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Admittedly, given how frequently her laptop overheated during video calls, Naomi eventually traced the issue to a buildup of dust inside the cooling fan rather than any software problem, something a technician confirmed after opening the case.
quests.hint: Find what Naomi's laptop frequently did during calls.
quests.explanation: The passage says it overheated, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given her family's history of diabetes, Sofia began scheduling annual blood sugar screenings in her early thirties rather than waiting until the typically recommended age, a decision her doctor fully supported given the added risk factor.
quests.hint: Find what Sofia began scheduling annually.
quests.explanation: The passage says blood sugar screenings, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given the runaway success of the first film's practical effects over computer-generated ones, the director insisted on using the same approach for the sequel despite pressure from the studio to cut costs with digital alternatives.
quests.hint: Find what type of effects the director insisted on using again.
quests.explanation: The passage says practical effects, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Revealingly, given that certain species of jellyfish are technically capable of reverting to an earlier stage of their life cycle when stressed or damaged, researchers have described them, somewhat controversially, as biologically immortal, even though individual jellyfish remain vulnerable to predation.
quests.hint: Find what certain jellyfish are technically capable of doing.
quests.explanation: The passage says reverting to an earlier stage, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Given the steep rise in reported cases of loneliness among older residents living alone, the city funded a program pairing seniors with trained volunteers for weekly companionship visits, an initiative that surveys suggest has meaningfully reduced isolation.
quests.hint: Find what type of weekly visits the volunteers provide.
quests.explanation: The passage says companionship visits, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: It would be easy to attribute Tomas's newfound consistency with exercise entirely to willpower, yet a closer look at what actually changed reveals something less flattering to that narrative: he simply moved his gym membership three minutes from his apartment.
quests.hint: Find what one might easily but wrongly credit for the change.
quests.explanation: The passage says willpower, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although it is frequently assumed that standardized test scores correlate straightforwardly with a student's overall academic ability, longitudinal research tracking students well beyond graduation has repeatedly found that non-cognitive factors predict long-term outcomes at least as strongly.
quests.hint: Find what type of research tracked students beyond graduation.
quests.explanation: The passage says longitudinal research, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Because turnover among entry-level staff had quietly become the department's costliest problem, largely invisible in the usual quarterly reports, the new manager pushed for exit interviews to finally be tracked systematically rather than treated as an afterthought.
quests.hint: Find the word describing how the problem appeared in quarterly reports.
quests.explanation: The passage says largely invisible, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the island is often marketed as an undiscovered paradise far off the beaten path, the reality that greets most visitors these days is a coastline dotted with resorts and a peak season so crowded that booking six months ahead has become standard.
quests.hint: Find how the island is often marketed.
quests.explanation: The passage says it is marketed as undiscovered, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Unsurprisingly, although Marcus and his siblings had assumed their parents' modest savings would comfortably cover a nursing home should the need ever arise, a frank conversation last year revealed that the actual costs would far exceed what had been set aside.
quests.hint: Find what the parents had set aside that turned out to be insufficient.
quests.explanation: The passage says their savings, so that is correct.

quests.instruction: Scan the text to find and select the target word.
quests.passage: Although the retailer's membership program advertises free shipping on all orders, the fine print reveals that this benefit applies only to orders shipped within the same country, leaving international members to pay standard rates regardless of status.
quests.hint: Find what type of program advertises free shipping.
quests.explanation: The passage says the membership program, so that is correct.
